failure_stage: production support-map validation on the first locked ROI
exception_message: R2 and SNR support maps must be finite.
root_cause: The public PSHG support maps use non-finite values outside the instrument-supported domain. The frozen validation excludes those pixels with a finite-value eligibility mask, whereas the v1 production implementation incorrectly required every support-map pixel to be finite.
amendment_rule: Do not impute or interpolate support values. In v1.1, record non-finite counts, convert them only to finite below-threshold sentinels at the interface to the immutable v1 evaluator, and therefore mark them ineligible exactly as the frozen validation does. Freeze v1.1 before computing any reference error.
claim_boundary: This receipt is an engineering failure, not evidence against the orientation estimator and not a clinical result.
